label: New snow (24 h)
description: Settled new snow in the 24 hours before the midnight reading. Full marks at a foot.

label: Storm total (72 h)
description: New snow over the last three days. Leftovers still ski well; full marks at two feet.

label: Snow density
description: Water content of the 72-hour storm snow. Lighter is better: full marks at 8% or less and none at 18% or more. Scaled down when the storm total is under 6 inches.

label: Cold preservation
description: Mean air temperature over the last three days. Cold keeps snow soft: full marks at 18°F or colder and none at 36°F or warmer.

label: Base depth
description: Snow on the ground at the station. Full marks at five feet.

label: Forecast (72 h)
description: National Weather Service snowfall forecast for the next 72 hours. Only known for the day the pipeline ran.
